annotations.title: Cue sheet: writers, splits, ISRC, publisher

description: The clearance data a broadcaster or PRO filing needs for one cue: every credited writer with role, society and IPI, every publisher with its share, the ISRC and the album. Present it as a clean table. If a field is not returned, report it as not on file — never fill it from anywhere else — and point the user at info@songstoyoureyes.com for gaps. Licensing itself is arranged with the Songs To Your Eyes team, not in this conversation.
